main_text.p: rek vocalis, ut apud Aben Esram, Numer.35.19. & שָׁבוּר[?] Chirekatum, cum Chirek notatum.

שָׁבַשׁ שֶׁבֶשׁ הִשְׁתַּבֵּשׁ Perplexum, Attonitum, Obstupefactum esse: Confundi, Seduci, Corrumpi: כִּי בְגָלוּת נִשְׁתַּבְּשׁוּ הַנּוֹסְחָאוֹת Nam in captivitate confusa sunt exemplaria; sumpserunt unum ex hoc; & transtulerunt in aliud, &c. Kimchi, 1.Reg.17.14. שָׁבּוּשׁ Confusio, Perplexitas, Error, Corruptio. אִישׁ מְשׁוּבָּשׁ Vir perplexus.
שַׁבְּתַאִי, שַׁבָּת Saturnus planeta: גַּלְגַּל שַׁבְּתַי Sphaera Saturni.

שָׁגַח, הִשְׁגִּיחַ Providere, Prospicere: הַשְׁגָּחָה Providentia. הַשְׁגָּחָה הָאֱלֹהִית Providentia divina: הַשְׁגָּחָה הַכּוֹלֶלֶת Providentia universalis, פְּרָטִית particularis, Prov.15.3. in R.Levi. הַשְׁגָּחוֹת Contemplatio, Speculatio.

שָׁגַר Mittere, Emittere. שָׁגוּר Emissum: Assuetum: Usitatum, Promptum, Expeditum: אִם שְׁגוּרָה תְּפִלָּתוֹ בְּפִיו Si expedita sit precatio ejus in ore ipsius, si expedite egrediatur: שֵׁם שָׁמַיִם שָׁגוּר בְּפִיו Nomen Dei confuetum erat in ore ejus.
שָׁדַךְ Desponsare,Conjugio jungere. לִשְׁדֹּךְ הַבָּנוֹת Desponsare filias sabbatho licitum. שִׁידּוּךְ Desponsatio, Copulatio. שִׁדּוּכָנוּת Idem. שַׁדְכָן Copulator, Desponsator.

שָׁדַל, שְׁדַל הִשְׁתַּדֵּל Operam dare, Curare, Incumbere rei, Occupatum esse: הִשְׁתַּדֵּל לִהְיוֹת אִישׁ Cura ut te virum praebeas. הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּ Opera, Cura, Studium, Conatus solicitus. שְׁדַל Persuadere. שִׁדּוּל Persuasio.
שָׁדַר, שְׁדֵרָה Spina dorsi: חוּט הַשְּׁדֵרָה Filum spinae dorsi, quod ex cerebro per vertebras descendit.
שָׁהָה Morari, Tardare. שְׁהִיָּה Mora, Tardatio.
שָׁוָה Aequari. שְׁוָאָה Aequatio, Comparatio: Hinc ו׳ הַשְׁוָאָה Vau adaequationis, quod apodosin similitudinis denotat,

page.notes: Top-left and bottom edge marks, and the faint digitiser text at bottom right, are not printed text and are left out. Uncertain Hebrew vowel points and letters marked [?]: the Hebrew at the head of the first line, the Hebrew of the "השתדלו" entry, and the "ו׳" of the final entry. The Hebrew in the "השתדל להיות איש" entry is partly obscured; the transcription follows the visible letters. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. "quale" is set right, after the last line, and is taken as the catchword. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin are approximate. "confuetum" is printed as it stands.
